title: Dancing Lessons
statementMd:
There are $*n*$ people taking dancing lessons. Every person is characterized by his/her dancing skill $*a*_{*i*}$. At the beginning of the lesson they line up from left to right. While there is at least one couple of a boy and a girl in the line, the following process is repeated: the boy and girl who stand next to each other, having the minimal difference in dancing skills start to dance. If there are several such couples, the one first from the left starts to dance. After a couple leaves to dance, the line closes again, i.e. as a result the line is always continuous. The difference in dancing skills is understood as the absolute value of difference of $*a*_{*i*}$ variable. Your task is to find out what pairs and in what order will start dancing.

## Input

The first line contains an integer $*n*$ ($1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the number of people. The next line contains $*n*$ symbols `B` or `G` without spaces. `B` stands for a boy, `G` stands for a girl. The third line contains $*n*$ space-separated integers $*a*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7}$) — the dancing skill. People are specified from left to right in the order in which they lined up.

## Output

Print the resulting number of couples $*k*$. Then print $*k*$ lines containing two numerals each — the numbers of people forming the couple. The people are numbered with integers from $1$ to $*n*$ from left to right. When a couple leaves to dance you shouldn't renumber the people. The numbers in one couple should be sorted in the increasing order. Print the couples in the order in which they leave to dance.
statementZhMd:
有 $*n*$ 个人参加舞蹈课。每个人都有一个舞蹈能力值 $*a*_{*i*}$。上课开始时，他们从左到右排成一列。只要队列中还存在一对相邻的男孩和女孩，就重复进行以下过程：让舞蹈能力差值最小的一对相邻男孩和女孩开始跳舞。如果有多对满足条件，则让从左侧起第一对开始跳舞。一对人离开去跳舞后，队列会重新合拢，即队列始终保持连续。舞蹈能力差值定义为 $*a*_{*i*}$ 变量之差的绝对值。你的任务是求出哪些人将开始跳舞，以及他们开始跳舞的顺序。

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$1 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$）——人数。第二行包含 $*n*$ 个不带空格的字符 `B` 或 `G`。`B` 表示男孩，`G` 表示女孩。第三行包含 $*n*$ 个空格分隔的整数 $*a*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *a*_{*i*} ≤ 10^{7}$）——舞蹈能力值。所有人按照他们排队时从左到右的顺序给出。

## 输出格式

首先输出最终的配对数量 $*k*$。然后输出 $*k*$ 行，每行包含两个数字，表示组成一对的人。人从左到右编号为 $1$ 到 $*n*$。当一对人离开去跳舞时，不应重新给其余的人编号。每对中的两个编号应按递增顺序输出。按照各对人离开去跳舞的顺序输出这些配对。
